gloss: the second one; the second (in a sequence)

definitions.explanation: The second item in a series of countable things, or the second point in a list of reasons or steps. Built from the native counter {二|ふた}つ plus the ordinal suffix 〜{目|め}.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つ{目|め}の{角|かど}を{右|みぎ}です。
examples.english: It's right at the second corner.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つ{目|め}の{理由|りゆう}を{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.english: I will explain the second reason.

examples.japanese: この{駅|えき}から{二|ふた}つ{目|め}で{降|お}りて、{階段|かいだん}を{上|あ}がってください。
examples.english: Get off at the second stop from this station and go up the stairs.

notes:
The suffix 〜{目|め} turns a count into an ordinal, so {二|ふた}つ means "two items" but {二|ふた}つ{目|め} means "the second one."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}の{角|かど}: the second corner (in directions)
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}の{信号|しんごう}: the second traffic light
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}の{理由|りゆう}: the second reason
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}で{降|お}りる: to get off at the second stop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {二番目|にばんめ}: the second — interchangeable in ranking contexts, and preferred for order of rank
- {二回目|にかいめ}: the second time — counts occasions, not objects
